_note: Деталь 4 — PEEK Radome v2c (02_01 §5.2 + 01_04 §5.5). Hollow PEEK dome Ø25 (= Zone-3 flange) frozen. Wall 1.5-2.0 (RF vs strength). Cavity for PCB stack. NB cavity height is NOT antenna<->Ti clearance (that is cavityH - lockGrooveZ - t/2 = 8.0 at the bayonet datum) and the >=12 floor is OURS, not canon's (02_01 5.3 asks >=8) - 00_07 HW.33. Internal axial headroom is cavityH + inner cap radius, not cavityH. Shield bell >=3mm rise / R>=5 (anti-overgrowth, no callus edge). Bayonet socket = L-slot mating Деталь-3 lugs. Cathode O2 = side/perimeter (02_02 §1.2), NOT sealed under the dome.
name: radome

notes.material: PEEK (polyetheretherketone), medical grade - chosen for RF, not for strength: er 3.2 and tan d 0.003 at 868 MHz make it effectively transparent to the antenna, where water (er about 80) is the thing that is not (02_01 5.2). Canon names UV-stable PC/ASA coloured to bark as a declared alternative. Not a bio-contact part - but NOT mechanically idle either: 02_01 5.2 calls it an anti-vandal sealed cover, and 00_07 HW.33 makes its RIM a hard datum that the bayonet closes against, so treat the rim as a load-bearing face
notes.process: Thermal moulding (термолиття) is the route costed in 02_06 1.2 at the 1K tier; the rim, however, is a machined feature in the Z-stack chain (00_07 HW.33 carries it as CNC_radome_rim). No supplier is fixed. If your route differs, say so - the rim tolerance is what the seal depends on, so the forming route is not a free choice here
notes.post_process: Thermal moulding needs no metallurgical post-process; the only post-forming operation canon names for this part is the machined RIM that the Z-stack chain depends on (00_07 HW.33, CNC_radome_rim). If your route needs annealing or stress relief before that cut, say so - PEEK stress released after machining would drift exactly the seal datum
notes.surface_finish: NOT SPECIFIED IN CANON for the outer shell. Note what the part has to do before proposing one: it is the outward face of a device that sits on living bark for two decades, and 01_04 5.5 asks for a rounded top edge so callus cannot get a grip. A finish proposal is welcome; a finish assumption is not. The RIM is the exception - it is a sealing datum, not decoration (00_07 HW.33)
notes.coating_restriction: Nothing is applied to PEEK - 01_02 3.6 excludes ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic layers from PEEK surfaces outright. Beyond that map: any metallic or otherwise conductive coating, paint or label would defeat the single function this part exists for, since the antenna radiates THROUGH it (02_01 5.2). Consequence, not a canon clause - but it is the one that costs the link budget
notes.inspection: Wall thickness within the 1.5-2.0 mm band (02_01 5.2). ATTENTION: that band is an RF DESIGN band whose VNA validation has not been run (00_07 UNI.10), so it is a requirement to hold, not a measured margin to spend. ATTENTION 2, and it is the one that would scrap a batch: the SHIPPED geometry of this manifest is knowingly NOT the ratified geometry. THREE founder verdicts are ratified and NOT YET APPLIED to this part (00_07 HW.33), and they are not all held by the same thing - (a) the cap becomes a FLAT CROWN with an R5 edge instead of a full hemisphere, gated on the board budget of 00_07 HW.9; (b) the rim becomes FLAT against a SINGLE 1.344 mm groove in the flange, which is not budget-gated at all - the manifest still cuts an opposing 0.9 groove, and the shipped pair squeezes a CS 1.78 cord by MINUS 1.1 percent, i.e. it does not seal; (c) a local internal BOSS on the rim is to carry both the bayonet socket and the seal land, which no field of this manifest expresses yet. Do not cut a part from this manifest as an acceptance geometry until those land
extra: Деталь 4 of the mechanical stack; bayonet 1/4-turn onto Деталь 3 (the cathode flange), NEVER onto the Zone-1 gyroid anode - that mistake destroys the enzyme surface (02_01 5.2)
The cathode breathes O2 from the SIDE/perimeter under the bell, not from under this dome (01_04 5.5; 02_02 1.2 only cross-refs it) - the dome is not a gas reservoir

NO factory drawing exists for this part, and that is a RATIFIED DEFERRAL rather than a gap (00_07 HW.1, 2026-09-11): this geometry carries TWO ratified-but-unapplied verdicts of 00_07 HW.33 - a flat crown R5 in place of the hemisphere, and a flat rim with no counter-groove - so a sheet issued from today's generator would be wrong the moment it printed. Draw it TOGETHER with the application, never before. Until then these notes are the SOURCE of the acceptance contract and have no carrier
